thread:
elena: FYI infra will rotate model alias tomorrow 02:00 UTC. We need a short migration checklist, one-line TS/Py/curl snippets, and a tiny codemod (dry-run) for infra templates. Target merge by 23:00 UTC tonight.
tia: I can own the codemod. plan: node script that replaces exact ids and optionally swaps call form. dry-run default.
sam: I'll update TS quickstarts and add a fallback handler for 412 that retries with the family alias.
jordan: I'll take Python and add a pytest that greps example configs for deprecated ids.
maria: I'll write the migration checklist page and a support FAQ. include how to detect pinned ids and how to verify post-flip.
elena: Callout: family aliases (e.g., "open-llama") will route, pinned exact ids (open-llama-v1) will return 412 after flip. Canonical new id is open-llama-2-compat.
sam: Old TS snippet we still have: `await client.models.predict({ model: "open-llama-v1", prompt: "Summarize" })`
sam: New suggested TS snippet: `await client.responses.create({ model: "open-llama-2-compat", input: "Summarize" })`
sam: 412 fallback (TS): `try { ... } catch (err) { if (err.status==412) { return client.responses.create({model: 'open-llama', input}) }}`
jordan: Python swap: old: `client.models.predict('open-llama-v1', prompt='...')` -> new: `client.responses.create(model='open-llama-2-compat', input='...')`
jordan: Python 412 fallback: `except APIError as e: if e.code==412: client.responses.create(model='open-llama', input=inp)`
tia: Codemod summary: node replace-lm.js --dry-run will print matches. To run: `node replace-lm.js --apply`. Script lives in /tools/codemods. It targets literal occurrences and common SDK call patterns.
maria: Migration checklist draft: 1) run codemod (dry-run) 2) update quickstarts/snippets 3) verify sample request returns model metadata == open-llama-2-compat or alias 4) update infra/helm/env vars 5) merge docs by 23:00 UTC.
elena: Add ops note: recommend jittered exponential backoff for 429/503 spikes during flip and a rollback plan. alex will post in #release-war-room 15m prior.
sam: PRs: TS snippets PR up at https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4601; includes fallback.
jordan: Py PR at https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4602 with tests. CI preview link in PR.
tia: Codemod PR at https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4603. dry-run output attached in PR.
docs-bot: Previews: https://deploy-preview-4601--docs.redwood.ai, https://deploy-preview-4602--docs.redwood.ai, https://deploy-preview-4603--docs.redwood.ai
maria: I'll add a short grep command in the checklist: `grep -R "open-llama-v1" -n .` and a Helm tip for values.yaml.
elena: Good. Merge target 23:00 UTC, infra flip 02:00 UTC. Ping me or @maria if blockers.
